get_builtin_metadata: create a function that builds a metadata dict with thing classes and contiguous IDs from OID categories
register_oid_instances_train: register the OID train split dataset instance using predefined image and annotation paths
register_oid_instances_val_expanded: register the OID validation expanded split dataset instance with official hierarchy annotations
register_oid_instances_val_expanded_rare: register the OID validation expanded rare split dataset instance for rare category evaluation
load_oid_categories: load the 500 predefined Open Images dataset categories with IDs, names, and Freebase IDs
